title: Leo, you can shine for no one and still be held
caption: for the leos who keep the porch light on

scenes.text: ruled by the sun, so of course rooms turn toward you.
you remember the birthdays. you take the late call.
but some nights you wonder who'd stay in the dark.
here's what the sky knows about the sun:
it keeps burning, even with half the world turned away.
so you don't have to earn the warmth you give away.
and you don't have to dazzle to be worth staying for.
let someone read your sky before they see the glow.
warmth is meant to come back to you, too.
you can shine for no one and still ask to be held.
you don't have to audition for the morning, leo.
